{07 14 00}I like having a few fish
around to keep me company
at home, {04 1f 00}.
Even if I don't have any
friends, {07 09 00}I can always talk
to my fishies, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

{07 14 00}I put a ton of fish tanks
in my room!
 
{07 17 00}I think it finally looks
like a professional
aquarium!

{07 14 00}My room looks good, and it
smells great! Nothing like
fish to freshen a place!
{07 0d 00}And the more you have,
the better it smells! It's
amazing, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
